name: PR preview deploy

# Publishes every pull request's build to a hosted, gated preview URL so decks
# and Engagement Wrapped PRs can be reviewed on a real device before merge.
#
# WHY CLOUDFLARE PAGES (not GitHub Pages): production is GitHub Pages served
# from `main` at decks.scrollmedia.co. A repo's GitHub Pages serves exactly one
# source, so per-PR previews there would require committing builds into `main`
# (pollutes production) or moving production off `main` (touches production).
# Cloudflare Pages gives per-branch preview URLs on *.pages.dev and never
# touches the GitHub Pages production site. See .github/PR_PREVIEW_SETUP.md.
#
# This workflow does nothing until the two repo secrets in the setup doc exist.

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write   # to post the preview URL as a PR comment

concurrency:
  group: pr-preview-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Secrets are not exposed to fork PRs; only run for same-repo branches.
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR build
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages (preview)
        id: deploy
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          # Deploy the repo root so every deck gets a preview path.
          # --branch = the PR branch, which marks this a *preview* (never production).
          command: >-
            pages deploy .
            --project-name=scroll-proposals-preview
            --branch="${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}"
            --commit-dirty=true

      - name: Comment the preview URL on the PR
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.deploy.outputs.deployment-url != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          PREVIEW_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.deployment-url }}
        with:
          script: |
            const base = process.env.PREVIEW_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
            const body = [
              '### 🔎 Preview deploy ready',
              '',
              `Root: ${base}`,
              `Launch Party Wrapped: ${base}/launch-party-wrapped/  (gate code: \`launchparty.scroll\`)`,
              '',
              '_Cloudflare Pages preview. Production (decks.scrollmedia.co) is untouched; it deploys from `main` via GitHub Pages only on merge._',
              '_Previews carry `noindex,nofollow`; the gate still applies._'
            ].join('\n');
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, issue_number: context.issue.number
            });
            const marker = '### 🔎 Preview deploy ready';
            const existing = comments.find(c => c.body && c.body.startsWith(marker));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({ owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, comment_id: existing.id, body });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({ owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, issue_number: context.issue.number, body });
            }
